page.title: 間接話法は視点から再構成

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、話者の正確な言葉を引用符内に保存する直接話法と、報告者の立場から人称・時制・場所・時間を組み直す間接話法を対比する。過去の伝達動詞に合わせた基本的な時制後退、現在も真である事実では時制を保てること、saidだけでなくadmit・warn・confirmなど発言の働きに合う伝達動詞を選ぶことを扱う。
grammarPoints: 直接話法は引用符を用いて話者の正確な語句と視点を保存する
間接話法ではI・youなどの代名詞を報告者と聞き手の関係に合わせて変える
過去のsaid・told・reportedなどの後ではwill→would、can→could、現在→過去、過去→過去完了が基本となる
報告時点でも有効な一般事実・製品仕様・規則は機械的に過去へずらさないことがある
sayはsay to＋人、tell・remind・informは動詞＋人＋that節など、それぞれの型に従う
admit・warn・confirm・announceなど、元発言の機能を表す伝達動詞で内容を自然に再構成できる
visualEvidence: 引用符で原発言をそのまま示すDIRECT SPEECHと、報告者側で文を組み直すINDIRECT SPEECHの左右対比
人称・時間・報告時点・正確な文言の必要性を順に確認する変換機構
willからwouldへ視点を一段ずらす時制矢印と、現在も真なら保持できる注意書き
saidをadmittedなどへ置き換え、単語ではなく発言の働きを報告するカード
引用文と伝達節のコンマ・引用符、および通常の代名詞主語語順を示す例
commonTraps: 過去の伝達動詞の後でもwillやcanを無条件にそのまま残す
元発言のI・you・myを報告者の視点へ変えず、指示対象を取り違える
過去より前の出来事を単純過去にして時間関係を曖昧にする
現在も有効な事実まで必ず過去形にしなければならないと考える
said meやexplained meのように伝達動詞の目的語・前置詞の型を誤る
直接引用で引用符・コンマの位置を誤り、普通の業務文でsaid sheのような不自然な倒置を使う

questions.prompt: At yesterday's briefing, Ms. Patel said that the new service ------- in October.

choices.A: will launch
choices.B: has launched
choices.C: would launch
choices.D: launches

questions.translationJa: 昨日の説明会で、パテルさんは新サービスが10月に開始されると述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の伝達動詞saidから見た未来なので、willを一段過去へずらしたwould launchが適切です。
questions.focus: 間接話法のwill→would

questions.prompt: The warehouse manager told the drivers that ------- should use the east gate.

choices.A: they
choices.B: we
choices.C: you
choices.D: he

questions.translationJa: 倉庫責任者は運転手たちに、彼らは東門を使うべきだと伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告される発言の聞き手driversを間接話法内で指すため、三人称複数のtheyを使います。
questions.focus: 報告者視点での代名詞

questions.prompt: Mr. Ortega admitted that he ------- the wrong attachment to the client.

choices.A: sends
choices.B: will send
choices.C: has been sending
choices.D: had sent

questions.translationJa: オルテガさんは、顧客に誤った添付ファイルを送ってしまったと認めました。
questions.explanationJa: 送信は過去のadmittedより前に起きたため、過去完了had sentで時間関係を明確にします。
questions.focus: 過去の報告より前の過去完了

questions.prompt: The technician explained that the backup system ------- independently of the main server.

choices.A: operated only yesterday
choices.B: operates
choices.C: would operated
choices.D: operating

questions.translationJa: 技術者は、予備システムは主サーバーとは独立して作動すると説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在も成り立つ製品仕様・一般的事実は、過去のexplainedの後でも現在形operatesを保てます。
questions.focus: 現在も有効な事実の時制

questions.prompt: “The replacement parts are on the way,” the supplier ------- in an email.

choices.A: confirmed
choices.B: confirming
choices.C: has confirm
choices.D: confirmation

questions.translationJa: 「交換部品は輸送中です」と仕入先はメールで確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: 引用文を受ける述語動詞の過去形が必要で、confirmedが文法・意味とも自然です。
questions.focus: 直接話法の伝達動詞

questions.prompt: The receptionist said that she ------- me when a meeting room became available.

choices.A: will notified
choices.B: notifies yesterday
choices.C: would notify
choices.D: has notifying

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は、会議室が空いたら私に知らせると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のsaid時点では通知が未来の行為なのでwould notifyを使います。
questions.focus: 未来から未来-in-the-pastへの変換

questions.prompt: The finance director ------- the board that the figures were preliminary.

choices.A: said
choices.B: reminded
choices.C: explained
choices.D: spoke

questions.translationJa: 財務部長は取締役会に、その数値は暫定的だと念を押しました。
questions.explanationJa: remindはremind＋人＋that節の型を取り、the boardを直接目的語にできます。
questions.focus: 伝達動詞remind＋人＋that

questions.prompt: According to the minutes, the chairperson stated that no decision ------- before legal review.

choices.A: will make
choices.B: was making
choices.C: has made
choices.D: would be made

questions.translationJa: 議事録によると、議長は法務確認前には決定を行わないと述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のstatedから見た将来の受動なので、would be madeが必要です。
questions.focus: 間接話法の未来受動

questions.prompt: Ms. Nguyen reported that the courier ------- twenty minutes earlier.

choices.A: arrives
choices.B: would arrive tomorrow
choices.C: had arrived
choices.D: has arriving

questions.translationJa: グエンさんは、配達員が20分前に到着していたと報告しました。
questions.explanationJa: 到着はreportedより前で、earlierも過去の基準点を示すためhad arrivedが適切です。
questions.focus: 報告時より前の出来事

questions.prompt: The guide said ------- the visitors that the museum would close at five.

choices.A: to
choices.B: at
choices.C: for
choices.D: with

questions.translationJa: 案内係は来館者に、美術館は5時に閉館すると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: sayは聞き手を直接目的語にできないため、say to＋人＋that節とします。
questions.focus: say to＋人

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence reporting a future delivery.

choices.A: The vendor said that the equipment will arrived on Friday.
choices.B: The vendor said that the equipment would arrive on Friday.
choices.C: The vendor told that the equipment would arrive on Friday.
choices.D: The vendor said the equipment would arrived on Friday.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は、機器が金曜日に到着すると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のsaidから見た未来はwould＋動詞原形arriveで表します。tellは聞き手なしではこの形にできません。
questions.focus: said＋that節とwould＋原形

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence containing a direct quotation.

choices.A: “Please submit the form by noon”, Ms. Ellis said.
choices.B: “Please submit the form by noon” Ms. Ellis said.
choices.C: Please submit the form by noon,” Ms. Ellis said.“
choices.D: “Please submit the form by noon,” Ms. Ellis said.

questions.translationJa: 「正午までに書類を提出してください」とエリスさんは言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 引用文末のコンマを閉じ引用符の内側に置き、その後に伝達節を続ける形が正しいです。
questions.focus: 直接引用の句読法

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting a currently valid fact.

choices.A: The engineer explained that the device requires a grounded outlet.
choices.B: The engineer explained that does the device require a grounded outlet.
choices.C: The engineer explained the device requiring a grounded outlet was.
choices.D: The engineer explained me that the device requires a grounded outlet.

questions.translationJa: 技術者は、その機器には接地されたコンセントが必要だと説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在も有効な仕様なのでrequiresを保てます。内容節は平叙文語順で、explain meとはしません。
questions.focus: 現在も真である内容の時制

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using an appropriate reporting verb.

choices.A: Mr. Diaz admitted me that he overlooked the final invoice.
choices.B: Mr. Diaz admitted to had overlooked the final invoice.
choices.C: Mr. Diaz admitted that he had overlooked the final invoice.
choices.D: Mr. Diaz admitted that had he overlooked the final invoice.

questions.translationJa: ディアスさんは、最終請求書を見落としていたと認めました。
questions.explanationJa: admit＋that節が正しく、過去のadmittedより前の見落としをhad overlookedで表しています。
questions.focus: admit＋that節と時制

questions.prompt: Choose the correct indirect report of a customer's words.

choices.A: The customer said that I could collect the order this afternoon.
choices.B: The customer told that she can collected the order that afternoon.
choices.C: The customer said could she collect the order that afternoon.
choices.D: The customer said that she could collect the order that afternoon.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は、その日の午後に注文品を受け取れると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 発言者をsheで指し、canをcouldへ、this afternoonをthat afternoonへ視点に合わせています。
questions.focus: 代名詞・助動詞・時表現の再構成

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a reporting clause after a quotation.

choices.A: “The lobby is now open,” announced she in ordinary business prose.
choices.B: “The lobby is now open,” she announced.
choices.C: “The lobby is now open” she announced,.
choices.D: “The lobby is now open”, she announcing.

questions.translationJa: 「ロビーは現在開いています」と彼女は発表しました。
questions.explanationJa: 通常の業務文では代名詞主語sheを動詞announcedの前に置き、引用符内にコンマを置きます。
questions.focus: 引用後の通常語順

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence distinguishing said from told.

choices.A: The supervisor said us that the inspection had been postponed.
choices.B: The supervisor told that the inspection had been postponed us.
choices.C: The supervisor told us that the inspection had been postponed.
choices.D: The supervisor told to us that the inspection had postponed.

questions.translationJa: 上司は私たちに、点検が延期されたと伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: tellはtell＋人＋that節の型を取り、延期は受動のhad been postponedです。
questions.focus: tell＋人＋that節

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting an earlier action.

choices.A: The assistant reported that she had mailed the contract the day before.
choices.B: The assistant reported that she mailed the contract tomorrow.
choices.C: The assistant reported had she mailed the contract yesterday.
choices.D: The assistant reported that she has mail the contract the day before.

questions.translationJa: アシスタントは、前日に契約書を郵送していたと報告しました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告より前の行為はhad mailed、報告時点から見た前日はthe day beforeとします。
questions.focus: 過去完了とthe day before

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence preserving the speaker's exact words.

choices.A: Mr. Roy said “I have not approved this expense”.
choices.B: Mr. Roy said that, “I have not approved this expense.”
choices.C: Mr. Roy said, “He had not approved that expense.”
choices.D: Mr. Roy said, “I have not approved this expense.”

questions.translationJa: ロイさんは「私はこの経費を承認していません」と言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 直接話法では話者の正確な語を引用符内に保ち、伝達節との間にコンマを置きます。
questions.focus: 直接話法での原発言保持

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a meaning-specific reporting verb.

choices.A: The manager warned the road to the branch might icy.
choices.B: The manager warned that the road to the branch might be icy.
choices.C: The manager warned that might the road to the branch be icy.
choices.D: The manager said a warning that the road to the branch may icy.

questions.translationJa: 部長は、支店へ向かう道路が凍結している可能性があると警告しました。
questions.explanationJa: 危険情報にはwarnedが自然で、that節は平叙文語順、mightの後はbeです。
questions.focus: warn＋that節

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I will send the revised estimate tonight,” Lena said.

choices.A: Lena said that I had sent the revised estimate the previous night.
choices.B: Lena asked whether the estimate should be revised.
choices.C: Lena denied sending any estimate that night.
choices.D: Lena said that she would send the revised estimate that night.

questions.translationJa: レナは、その晩に改訂見積書を送ると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: I→she、will→would、tonight→that nightと報告者の視点へ移した間接話法です。
questions.focus: 直接話法から間接話法

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The accountant admitted that she had entered the amount incorrectly.”

choices.A: The accountant instructed someone to change a correct entry.
choices.B: The accountant acknowledged making an incorrect entry.
choices.C: The accountant claimed that every amount was correct.
choices.D: The accountant was unaware that an entry existed.

questions.translationJa: 会計担当者は、誤った入力をしたことを認めました。
questions.explanationJa: admitted that she had entered...をacknowledged making...へ言い換えても、誤りを認めた意味を保ちます。
questions.focus: 伝達動詞と動名詞による言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The director said, ‘The office is closed today.’”

choices.A: The director asked why the office would open the next day.
choices.B: The director ordered the staff to close every office permanently.
choices.C: The director stated that the office was closed that day.
choices.D: The director denied knowing whether the office was closed.

questions.translationJa: 取締役は、その日は事務所が閉まっていると述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 直接引用の内容を、発言者と報告時点に合わせた間接話法へ自然に言い換えています。
questions.focus: 直接引用から間接話法への再構成

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The technician explained that the sensor works without a cable.”

choices.A: According to the technician, the sensor operates wirelessly.
choices.B: The technician said the sensor would stop unless its cable was replaced.
choices.C: The sensor explained how the technician should work.
choices.D: The technician refused to discuss the sensor.

questions.translationJa: 技術者によれば、そのセンサーは無線で作動します。
questions.explanationJa: works without a cableをoperates wirelesslyへ言い換え、情報源も保っています。
questions.focus: 現在も有効な説明の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Our representative told us that the client had accepted the proposal.”

choices.A: Our representative asked us to accept the client's proposal.
choices.B: Our representative informed us that the proposal had been accepted by the client.
choices.C: The client was told to prepare a different proposal.
choices.D: Our representative said the client would reject the proposal.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は、提案が顧客に受け入れられたと私たちに知らせました。
questions.explanationJa: told usをinformed usへ、能動を受動へ変えても、情報の内容と受け手は同じです。
questions.focus: tellとinform・能受変換

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The clerk said that the train had left ten minutes earlier.”

choices.A: The clerk predicted that the train would leave in ten minutes.
choices.B: The train left ten minutes after the clerk's report.
choices.C: The clerk asked whether the train was still at the platform.
choices.D: The clerk reported that the train had departed ten minutes before the report.

questions.translationJa: 係員は、報告の10分前に列車が出発していたと伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: earlierの基準が過去の報告時点であることを明示した同義文です。
questions.focus: earlierの過去基準

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mira said, ‘I can help you with the display.’”

choices.A: Mira offered to help the listener with the display.
choices.B: Mira said that the listener had already helped her.
choices.C: Mira warned the listener not to touch the display.
choices.D: Mira asked the listener to build a different display alone.

questions.translationJa: ミラは聞き手に、展示を手伝うと申し出ました。
questions.explanationJa: can helpという発言の機能をoffered to helpで自然に再構成しています。
questions.focus: 発言機能を表す報告動詞

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The report says that demand is increasing.”

choices.A: The report predicted that demand had ended permanently.
choices.B: Demand increased only because the report was published.
choices.C: The report indicates that demand is currently rising.
choices.D: The report contains no information about demand.

questions.translationJa: その報告書は、需要が現在増加していることを示しています。
questions.explanationJa: says thatをindicates thatへ、is increasingをis currently risingへ変えて同じ現在の傾向を表します。
questions.focus: 現在の報告内容の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mr. Klein said that he had forgotten to reserve a room.”

choices.A: Mr. Klein acknowledged that the room reservation had slipped his mind.
choices.B: Mr. Klein remembered reserving several rooms.
choices.C: Mr. Klein instructed someone to cancel a room.
choices.D: Mr. Klein said the reservation system had forgotten him.

questions.translationJa: クラインさんは、部屋の予約を忘れていたと認めました。
questions.explanationJa: forgotten to reserveとthe reservation had slipped his mindは同じ失念を表し、acknowledgedも認める意味です。
questions.focus: 報告内容の語彙的言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager said, ‘We need more time.’”

choices.A: The manager ordered the team to finish immediately.
choices.B: The manager denied that time was limited.
choices.C: The manager asked how much the extra work would cost.
choices.D: The manager stated that the team needed additional time.

questions.translationJa: 部長は、チームには追加の時間が必要だと述べました。
questions.explanationJa: weをteamに具体化し、needを過去の報告視点neededへ変えた同義の間接話法です。
questions.focus: 集団代名詞と時制の再構成

questions.prompt: Yesterday, the supplier promised to check the stock. It said that it ------- us by this morning.

choices.A: will contacted
choices.B: contacts last week
choices.C: would contact
choices.D: has contacting

questions.translationJa: 昨日、仕入先は在庫を確認すると約束しました。今朝までに当社へ連絡すると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のsaidから見た将来の連絡なのでwould contactを選びます。
questions.focus: 文脈内の未来-in-the-past

questions.prompt: The client called while Ms. Green was away. I told him that ------- would return after lunch.

choices.A: I
choices.B: she
choices.C: you
choices.D: they office

questions.translationJa: グリーンさんが不在の間に顧客から電話がありました。私は、彼女は昼食後に戻ると伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: 話題のMs. Greenを報告文内で三人称単数のsheに置き換えます。
questions.focus: 指示対象に合う代名詞

questions.prompt: The audit ended on Tuesday. On Wednesday, the lead auditor reported that the team ------- no major errors.

choices.A: finds
choices.B: will find
choices.C: has been find
choices.D: had found

questions.translationJa: 監査は火曜日に終了しました。水曜日、主任監査人はチームが重大な誤りを見つけなかったと報告しました。
questions.explanationJa: 発見の有無は水曜のreportedより前の監査中のことなので、had foundを使います。
questions.focus: 報告より前の出来事

questions.prompt: The manual was published five years ago, but its safety rule remains valid. The trainer explained that every operator ------- protective gloves.

choices.A: must wear
choices.B: had wore
choices.C: would wearing
choices.D: wear yesterday

questions.translationJa: 手引書は5年前に発行されましたが、その安全規則は今も有効です。講師は全作業者が保護手袋を着用しなければならないと説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在も有効な義務なのでmust wearを保つのが自然です。mustの後は動詞原形です。
questions.focus: 現在も有効な義務の保持

questions.prompt: A customer wrote, “I received the wrong color.” In her reply, the agent noted that the customer ------- the wrong color.

choices.A: would receive tomorrow
choices.B: receives every day
choices.C: had received
choices.D: receiving

questions.translationJa: 顧客は「違う色の商品を受け取りました」と書きました。返信で担当者は、その顧客が違う色を受け取っていたと記しました。
questions.explanationJa: 受け取りは担当者がnotedするより前なのでhad receivedが適切です。
questions.focus: 引用内容の過去完了化

questions.prompt: The fire alarm sounded during the meeting. “Please use the stairs,” the security officer -------.

choices.A: announcement
choices.B: announced
choices.C: announcing
choices.D: has announce

questions.translationJa: 会議中に火災警報が鳴りました。「階段を利用してください」と警備員はアナウンスしました。
questions.explanationJa: 引用文に続く伝達節には、完結した過去の述語動詞announcedが必要です。
questions.focus: 直接引用後の伝達動詞

questions.prompt: The delivery date has not changed. Nevertheless, several customers said that they ------- a postponement notice.

choices.A: had received
choices.B: would receive next year
choices.C: receive always
choices.D: has receiving

questions.translationJa: 配送日は変更されていません。それにもかかわらず、数人の顧客は延期通知を受け取っていたと述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 通知受領はsaidより前の出来事なのでhad receivedを使います。
questions.focus: 過去報告と先行する出来事

questions.prompt: At the trade show, the presenter said, “Our battery lasts twelve hours.” In the summary written that evening, I reported that the battery ------- twelve hours.

choices.A: will lasting
choices.B: has lasts
choices.C: would lasted
choices.D: lasted

questions.translationJa: 展示会で発表者は「当社のバッテリーは12時間持続します」と言いました。その晩の要約で、私はバッテリーが12時間持続すると報告しました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の発言を同じ日の過去の報告へ移すため、現在形lastsを一段過去のlastedにできます。
questions.focus: 現在形の基本的な時制後退

questions.prompt: The branch manager called from Sapporo on Monday and said, “I will return here tomorrow.” On Tuesday, headquarters reported that she would return ------- that day.

choices.A: here to the original speaker
choices.B: there
choices.C: now yesterday
choices.D: ago

questions.translationJa: 支店長は月曜日に札幌から電話し、「明日ここへ戻ります」と言いました。火曜日、本社は彼女がその日にそこへ戻ると報告しました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告者である本社は札幌にいないため、元発言のhereをthereへ変えます。
questions.focus: 場所表現here→there

questions.prompt: The operations chief did not merely say that a delay was possible; he emphasized the risk. The minutes therefore state that he ------- that shipments might be late.

choices.A: asked
choices.B: promised
choices.C: warned
choices.D: congratulated

questions.translationJa: 業務責任者は遅延の可能性を単に述べただけでなく、危険性を強調しました。そのため議事録には、出荷が遅れる恐れがあると警告したと記されています。
questions.explanationJa: 危険性を強調した文脈には、単なるsaidではなくwarnedが最も適切です。
questions.focus: 発言機能に合う伝達動詞
